text:
Ana: Quick huddle — biz wants MVP end of month. We need a crisp cutlist now. Risk areas: full pin-management UI, long-retention route telemetry, embeddings dashboard, and eval automation.
Devon: Lay out a minimal safe surface.
Ana: My proposal: MVP ships runtime + core REST API + pin primitive (API only) + rollback API + tiny CLI + a single-line console banner that shows the active pinned model and a link to the CLI. Defer full UI, tag filters, and dashboards to v1.
Kai: Frontend for full pin UI is 3 sprints. Backend rollback + audit log is quick.
Raj: Pilots (Acme, Greenleaf) said dashboards are nice but blocking items are rollback speed and predictable latency.
Marie: UX: banner must say "Pinned models are tenant-global" and include a one-click copyable CLI snippet. I'll draft.
Leo: Ops ask: include a Grafana starter dashboard template and /metrics export so customers can self-serve visibility without a full product dashboard. Low lift.
Devon: Estimates: rollback API + audit logs = 3 dev-days; CLI + docs + banner = 6 dev-days; Grafana template + metrics hook = 2 dev-days; canary toggle UI = 2 dev-days; safety tests = 4 dev-days. Total ~17 dev-days.
Kai: I'll run SLA validation to prove rollback < 3m and canary adds <500ms latency.
release-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 6 business days. last build cutoff: 4290005400.
Ana: Actions: Devon confirm estimates by EOD; Kai validate SLAs; Marie draft banner & CLI snippet; Leo produce Grafana template; Raj confirm pilot buy-in. I'll update the milestone tracker with this cut and tag deferred items for v1.
Raj: Pinged pilots. Waiting on thumbs.
Marie: :thumbsup: will post copy in #docs once ready.
Devon: noted, will confirm.
Ana: Aim to lock scope tomorrow. If pilots push back, we have a fallback to push the banner and CLI as a hotfix within 1 sprint.
